speaker: Gérald Caussé
role: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles
title: The Gift of Testimony
summary: Elder Caussé teaches that bearing witness of Jesus Christ is not only the work of Apostles but a duty and privilege of every covenant disciple, and that testimony and love are twin gifts that strengthen each other. He frames it with D&C 68:6 coming to him when called as a Seventy and again at his first testimony as an Apostle, and with a niece whose two-sentence testimony at Young Women camp was enough. He invites everyone to look each day for chances, even a minute or two, to say "I know" as freely as "I love you."

“Be of good cheer, and do not fear, for I the Lord am with you, and will stand by you; and ye shall bear record of me, even Jesus Christ.”
I had just been called to serve as one of the Lord’s Apostles and was invited to join the First Presidency and the Twelve in their sacred meeting room.

findings.quote: to bear witness of the Redeemer of the world
“Ye shall be witnesses unto me.”
divinely empowered witness of the living Christ

findings.quote: Our testimony is not a talent to be hidden.

findings.quote: Testimony and love are deeply connected gifts that echo and strengthen one another.

findings.quote: I hope you will fill your lives, and the lives of others, with many heartfelt I knows—as I hope you already do with many I love yous.

findings.quote: One of our nieces recently shared an experience from her youth.
findings.note: A niece's two-sentence testimony at Young Women camp, and her mother's reassurance

detail.about: a nervous niece bears a two-sentence testimony and her mother says that is all that matters

findings.quote: One of our nieces
I was so nervous that I only managed to say two simple sentences: ‘I know that God loves me’ and ‘I know that God has a plan for me.’
I talked with my mom, and she asked, ‘Do you believe what you said?’
findings.note: The niece's mother, his sister or sister-in-law

findings.quote: ‘Then that’s all that matters,’ she said.
It need not be long, eloquent, or dramatic—it only needs to be true.

detail.purpose: what a testimony does not need to be

findings.quote: “the Holy Ghost shall be shed forth in bearing record unto all things whatsoever ye shall say.”
those whom He calls “the weak and the simple.”
From Enoch and Moses to Joseph Smith, and to the more than 90,000 missionaries serving throughout the world today, the pattern is the same.

detail.purpose: humble witnesses whose testimony carried divine power
